title: East Paulding Middle School: referrals
result: 85% drop in referrals in one term
details: Reported by Classcraft/HMH as a school case study. Useful as a concrete implementation example, but not a randomized causal estimate.

title: Tabor City Middle School: classroom disruptions
details: Vendor case study also reported referrals falling from 257 to 49 (80.9%), fights from 14 to 2, and several other incident categories declining. Treat as descriptive school-level evidence.

title: IES/SRI Initial Efficacy Study of Classcraft
result: Five-year randomized efficacy study funded in 2023
details: IES notes that Classcraft had not previously been rigorously studied in an RCT and describes use by over 30,000 teachers and 1 million active student participants at the time of the grant. Award period: 2023–2028.

title: Classcraft-centered content analysis and meta-analysis
details: 2021 review/meta-analysis of gamification platforms including Classcraft reported similar positive effects on learning achievement and motivation. Interpret as evidence for the broader approach, not a Classcraft-only causal effect.

title: The Gamification of Learning: a Meta-analysis
result: Cognitive g=0.49; motivational g=0.36; behavioral g=0.25
details: Random-effects meta-analysis found statistically significant small-to-moderate effects across cognitive, motivational and behavioral learning outcomes.

title: Does gamification improve student learning outcome?
details: 30 independent interventions and 3,202 participants. Qualitative synthesis also identified anxiety/jealousy as possible downsides, reinforcing the need for cooperative and non-shaming design.

title: School-Wide PBIS effectiveness trial
result: Students were 33% less likely to receive an office discipline referral
details: Group randomized trial across 37 elementary schools and 12,344 students over four school years; significant improvements were also reported in behavior problems, concentration, emotion regulation and prosocial behavior.

title: What Works Clearinghouse: Teacher-Delivered Behavioral Interventions K–5
result: Strong evidence for clear expectations, reminders, and acknowledgement of expected behavior
details: Supports the platform's emphasis on explicitly teaching expectations and providing positive feedback rather than relying on punishment mechanics.

title: Gamification and intrinsic motivation / psychological needs
result: Intrinsic motivation g=0.257; autonomy g=0.638; relatedness g=1.776
details: 35 interventions involving about 2,500 participants. Supports autonomy and relatedness as design targets while cautioning that competence effects were smaller.
